name: io.github.jahanv01/sec-intelligence-mcp
description: SEC 10-K/10-Q/8-K search, RAG Q&A, comparison, and anomaly detection with citations.
title: SEC Intelligence

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google Gemini API key (free tier). Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Qdrant vector database URL, e.g. http://localhost:6333 for local Docker, or a Qdrant Cloud cluster URL

environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Only needed for a hosted Qdrant Cloud instance; leave unset for local Qdrant

environmentVariables.name: LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: LangFuse secret key for observability (free tier). Get one at https://cloud.langfuse.com

environmentVariables.name: LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: LangFuse public key, paired with LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY

environmentVariables.name: SEC_EDGAR_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Identifying User-Agent for SEC EDGAR requests, e.g. "YourApp you@email.com"
